children: Hecto Group to showcase its key affiliates' capabilities through a unified booth at SFF 2026
Showcasing an integrated business ecosystem spanning wallets, global remittance, payments and settlement, data, and e-commerce
Building its own ecosystem through cross-affiliate synergies to foster tangible business partnerships with global partners

SEOUL, South Korea, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Korean business group Hecto Group is accelerating its global expansion through the "Hecto Group Ecosystem," which connects digital asset wallets, stablecoin-based global payment and remittance infrastructure, and e-commerce solutions.
Hecto Group will host a unified booth at Singapore FinTech Festival (SFF) 2026, taking place November 18–20 at Singapore EXPO.

Under the theme "THE HECTO ORBIT—Where Technology Connects Everyday Life" the booth will visualize how the technologies and services of each Hecto Group affiliate come together like orbits. Through the exhibition, Hecto Group aims to strengthen its presence in global markets while offering visitors a range of benefits. Hecto Innovation, an IT services company; Hecto Financial, a global fintech company; and Hecto Data, a data specialist, will take center stage at the unified booth, focusing on acquiring new customers and expanding global partnerships.

This marks Hecto Group's first participation in SFF at the group level. By showcasing an integrated ecosystem that connects Hecto Innovation's wallet solutions, Hecto Financial's global payment and settlement infrastructure, and Hecto Data's e-commerce solutions, the group aims to address the diverse needs of global financial institutions, fintech firms, and e-commerce companies.
Digital Asset Wallets: O-HI Wallet and Octet

Hecto Innovation will target global markets by leveraging wallet technology brought in-house through its acquisition of Hecto Walletone, a specialist in blockchain wallet infrastructure, last year. At SFF, the company will showcase O-HI Wallet, an in-app wallet, and Octet, an enterprise wallet infrastructure solution. It will also host a wallet event where digital assets are converted into rewards, supporting customer acquisition.

Visitors can participate in the wallet event by scanning QR codes displayed at the Hecto Group booth and other locations. Through a dedicated event wallet page, participants can receive coins (event points), which can be exchanged at the booth for beverages, merchandise, and other items. Participants can also enter a prize draw. Those who retain their unused coins will receive additional benefits at a later date.
Stablecoin Payments and Cross-Border Settlement

Hecto Financial will showcase its stablecoin-based global payment and settlement infrastructure, along with a range of payment and settlement services for global customers. To expand its global partnerships, the company will introduce:
Cross-border remittance service built on Circle Payments Network (CPN) for global businesses
Payment gateway (PG) and card processing services that enable global businesses to integrate various Korean payment methods through a single connection
Foreign currency settlement service that enables global merchants to manage funds in Korea without establishing a local Korean entity
Global KYC and E-commerce Solutions

Hecto Data will introduce its API-based global KYC (Know Your Customer) solution and e-commerce solutions. Leveraging SELLPICK, its integrated online store management solution, and Selling Booster, its e-commerce data platform, Hecto Data aims to expand its customer base among global e-commerce and fintech companies.
Healthcare and AI Media

In addition, Hecto Healthcare will introduce its healthcare products, including the premium probiotics De Simone and O2 Booster, in conjunction with the wallet event, further promoting Hecto Healthcare in global markets. Hecto Media will actively explore new business opportunities through cross-affiliate sales synergies, including a live demonstration of article distribution powered by its AI news system.

A Hecto Group spokesperson said, "Hecto Group is building its own ecosystem by connecting the technologies, services, and customers of its affiliates across wallets, payments and settlement, and data. As stablecoins emerge as next-generation payment infrastructure, we will leverage our technological and service capabilities to forge tangible business partnerships with a wide range of global partners."

Singapore FinTech Festival, organized by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), is Asia's largest fintech event, bringing together financial institutions, fintech companies, and investors from around the world to share the latest technologies and solutions and to explore the future of the financial industry. This year, around 600 companies are participating as sponsors and exhibitors, with more than 70,000 attendees from 142 countries and regions expected.
About Hecto Group

Hecto Group is a lifetech group whose businesses span fintech, data, digital asset wallets, healthcare, and media. Building on an ecosystem that connects the capabilities of its affiliates, the group is accelerating its expansion into global markets.
About Hecto Innovation

Hecto Innovation is an IT-based information services company offering services across information security, cybersecurity, fintech, and payments. Having started in IT information services, the company is expanding its platform business and global presence, while extending its business into digital asset wallets.
About Hecto Financial

Hecto Financial is a global fintech company that provides easy account-based payments, virtual accounts, firm banking, and payment gateway (PG) services, built on one of Korea's leading payment and settlement infrastructures. Backed by a proven track record of reliably processing more than KRW 1,200 trillion in transactions annually, the company is expanding its portfolio into global settlement and foreign exchange services, as well as digital asset-based payments.
About Hecto Data

Hecto Data is a data specialist providing data processing, analytics, and consulting services across a wide range of industries. The company has recently been expanding its e-commerce solutions business, including SELLPICK, an integrated online store management solution, and Selling Booster, an e-commerce data platform.
